The '''Methall'has sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].<ref name="Planets">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> It contained the [[Eedoq system/Legends|Eedoq system]].<ref name="Planets" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Methall'has sector was first mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', which stated it was near the Elrood sector.<ref name="Planets" /> The [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] later placed the existing Eedoq system in the sector and relegated it to a subsector of the Tantra sector.<ref name="EAOC" />
